```{R, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
```


# Geoms

Here, have a cookie...

## Subtask 1

... and a figure!

% format as gggrid?
```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_bar(aes(x=wt))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_point(aes(x=wt, y=mpg))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
#library(stringr)
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_boxplot(aes(as.factor(cyl), wt)) +
	geom_point(aes(x=as.factor(cyl), y=wt, col=mpg, shape=rownames(mtcars)))
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mtcars) +
	geom_label(aes(x=hp, y=cyl, label=rownames(mtcars)))
	#geom_text(aes(x=hp, y=cyl, label=rownames(mtcars)), check_overlap=TRUE)
```

```{R, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(iris) +
	geom_spoke(aes(x=0, y=0, col=Species, angle=Petal.Width/Petal.Length, radius=Petal.Length))
```
